2608.27510.title: How Do Linear Probes Emerge? A Circuit-Tracing Framework with Concept-Targeted Attribution
2608.27510.paper_summary: Transcoder attribution graphs are usually trained to explain why a model assigns high probability to a particular next token. We introduce Concept-Targeted Attribution (CTA), which instead trains attribution graphs with respect to a linear probe direction. CTA therefore yields probe-specific circuits that explain why an internal concept representation arises in a prompt, independently of whether it is expressed in the generated token. Using Cross-Layer Transcoders, we show that these probe-targeted graphs contain predictive structure: graph-level features predict probe accuracy across four widely studied concept categories ($ρ= 0.91$, $R^2 = 0.84$), while local features identify the sparse components driving per-prompt classification. This connects probe performance to interpretable circuit structure, allowing us to ask not only whether a probe works, but which internal computations make it work. Causal ablations further show that probe-targeted and logit-targeted graphs capture functionally distinct mechanisms. Removing probe-relevant features reduces internal concept scores while largely preserving generated tokens, whereas removing logit-relevant features changes the generated token in 92% to 100% of cases with near-zero effect on probe scores. CTA provides a framework for moving from behavioral probe accuracy to mechanistic explanations of probe performance, enabling more detailed audits of internal concept representations, including safety-critical ones. Our code is available at https://github.com/vedantpalit/concept-targeted-attribution
2608.27510.paper_summary_zh: 轉碼器歸因圖通常是為了解釋為什麼模型對特定的下一個標記分配高概率而訓練的。我們引入了概念目標歸因（CTA），它則是針對線性探針方向訓練歸因圖。因此，CTA 產生了特定於探針的電路，解釋了為什麼內部概念表示在提示中出現，而不管它是否在生成的標記中表達出來。使用跨層轉碼器，我們展示了這些針對探針的圖包含預測結構：圖層級特徵預測四個廣泛研究的概念類別中的探針準確性（$ρ= 0.91$, $R^2 = 0.84$），而局部特徵則識別出驅動每個提示分類的稀疏組件。這將探針性能與可解釋的電路結構聯繫起來，使我們不僅可以詢問探針是否有效，還可以詢問哪些內部計算使其有效。因果消融進一步顯示，針對探針和針對邏輯的圖捕捉到功能上不同的機制。移除與探針相關的特徵會降低內部概念分數，同時在很大程度上保留生成的標記，而移除與邏輯相關的特徵則在 92% 到 100% 的情況下改變生成的標記，對探針分數幾乎沒有影響。CTA 提供了一個框架，將行為探針準確性轉變為探針性能的機制解釋，使我們能夠對內部概念表示進行更詳細的審核，包括安全關鍵的概念。我們的代碼可在 https://github.com/vedantpalit/concept-targeted-attribution 獲得。
